<thought>The mass spectrum gives a monoisotopic mass of 114.068 Da, matching the formula C₆H₁₀O₂. The ¹³C NMR shows six signals: a carbonyl at 168.6 ppm (typical for an α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid), two sp² carbons at ~144 and ~130 ppm (the double‑bond carbons), and three aliphatic carbons around 22–19 ppm, consistent with three methyl groups attached to the double bond and the chiral center. The isomer “CC=C[C@H](C)C(=O)O” (3‑methyl‑2‑butenoic acid) fits this formula and the NMR pattern. Therefore the SMILES string for the sample is:

<final_answer>CC=C[C@H](C)C(=O)O</final_answer>
